Which 5 artists have the most albums?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH counts AS (
  SELECT a.ArtistId, ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS album_count
  FROM Album a
  JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
  GROUP BY a.ArtistId
)
SELECT ArtistId, Name, album_count
FROM counts
WHERE album_count >= (
  SELECT album_count FROM counts ORDER BY album_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4
)
ORDER BY album_count DESC, Name;"}
